Plan: let the hard start settle by min 2-3; hold shaft ~200-205 W (near CP) through legs 1-6, checking CP with heart-rate trend at steady effort (rising HR at steady power = above CP). Mid-race (around 4-5 km) consider a short piece to test CP / blade share if useful. Watch push_local for sudden drops not explained by turns (weed -> clear_rudder; or pod drift -> pod gain). Final ~1.2-1.5 km: spend remaining reserve, finish cue around 400-600 m. Listen to radio for course changes (set_race_distance).
